changelog: Bookings is now grouped into Bookings, Pending Requests, and Past Bookings / Match History.
Bookings is available to non-admin users from the bottom navigation, with confirmed court time and Request a Court Slot.
Waiting Queue now shows visible #1, #2, #3 positions.
Resting is removed from the live queue and finished players return to the end of the Queue.
On Deck stays editable until match start and can still be shuffled.
Duplicate full names or nicknames are intercepted; use existing player, change nickname, or discard.
Drea Mateo Messenger is configured as the proof-of-payment destination for the booking/payment flow.
